problem: Applying the locked Pre-Execution Search & Currency Procedure's step 3 (verify currency) to the Experience Layer's OWN Index (E7's v2) found it stale: 8/11 real experiences covered.

decision.decision_summary: Refresh the Index proactively (before it causes a real consumer failure, unlike PHASE-964's case which was caught reactively via a crash) by reusing E7's exact indexing logic.

action.action_summary: Built Experience Index v3 (additive) covering all 11 real experiences, using buildIndex() reused verbatim from E7.

result.note: Fixes an Experience Layer maintenance defect; does not change this Goal's own real status.

cause.root_cause_summary: The same class of defect as PHASE-964's (a snapshot artifact not kept in sync with a growing real data source) recurring in a DIFFERENT component (the Index itself) -- but this time caught proactively via the locked procedure's currency-check step, before any real consumer crashed on it.

lesson: The "verify currency" procedure step generalizes beyond the specific case it was invented for (PHASE-964's hardcoded filename) -- applying it to the Experience Layer's own Index caught the identical class of defect proactively. Any artifact that summarizes a growing real data source needs its OWN currency to be periodically re-checked, including the Experience Layer's own components.
